title: Comparative Study of Different Neoadjuvant Therapies Before Radical Hysterectomy in Stage Ib2-IIa2 Cervical Cancer
brief_summary: For stage Ib2-IIa2 cervical cancer patients, neoadjuvant therapy followed by radical hysterectomy and pelvic lymphadenectomy is one of the managements. Post-operative concurrent chemo-radiotherapy is necessary if the patients have high-risk factors, including positive surgical margin, parametrium and pelvic nodes. Our previous retrospective study showed that combination of neoadjuvant chemotherapy and brachytherapy reduced the proportion of post-operative concurrent chemo-radiotherapy compared to neoadjuvant chemotherapy alone.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Histology confirmed cervical cancer
* Clinical stage Ib2 or IIa2 (FIGO 2009)

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients who not suitable for surgery
* Personal history of pelvic radiotherapy
